results.title: Zoho vs Salesforce comparison: Which CRM platform to choose? - Blog
results.summary:
However, in general, most people will probably find Zoho CRM to be easier to use than Salesforce.

With Zoho CRM, the learning curve is generally pretty small and even non-technical users should feel at home pretty quickly. The interface is generally pretty intuitive and not overly complex.

With Salesforce, most people will experience a bit more of a learning curve, even when using the Salesforce Starter Suite.

Because of this, many organizations even hire dedicated Salesforce Administrators – expert users who can own the platform for that business. While you don’t need to hire a dedicated administrator, this learning curve is one reason why Salesforce can be more suited to larger organizations.

Overall, if you want the tool that’s the easiest to use and has the smallest learning curve, that might push you in the direction of Zoho CRM.

However, Zoho CRM’s comparatively simple approach also has some drawbacks, which we’ll discuss in the next section.

## Customizability: Which tool gives you more options for customization?

The advantage of Salesforce’s comparative complexity versus Zoho CRM is that Salesforce generally gives you a lot more options for customizing everything to your organization’s needs.

Salesforce doesn’t just have an advantage over Zoho CRM when it comes to customizability – Salesforce is just generally one of the most customizable CRM platforms in existence.

You can access a variety of different code-free and code-based customization tools, including interface-based customization as well as its own programming language called Apex. This language lets developers really dig in and build completely custom automation and logic processes.

You can also access a variety of apps via Salesforce AppExchange, which gives you even more flexibility for customizing your setup.

If you want/need the ability to fully customize your setup, especially enterprise-level customization, Salesforce could be the best option.

With that being said, some businesses, especially those on the smaller side, don’t need all that customization.

While Zoho CRM can’t match Salesforce when it comes to customization, Zoho CRM does still give you a decent amount of options to customize things, which might be enough for your business.

For example, you can add custom modules and fields and customize views and page layouts, which lets you store data and present it in a way that best works for your business.

You can also create automations using assignment rules, approval processes, workflow rules, and business process blueprints. This help article details some of the automation options.

## Pricing: What will you pay for Zoho CRM vs Salesforce?

Comparing pricing for Zoho CRM vs Salesforce can be a little tricky because there are a lot of variables involved.

In general, Zoho will often work out to be cheaper than Salesforce. However, the exact pricing differences will depend on your specific use case, such as the number of users you have, the specific features you need access to, and so on.

Below, we’ll do our best to compare pricing in as 1:1 a manner as possible.

### Free plans

Before we talk about the paid plans, one notable difference between these two tools is that Zoho CRM offers a free plan while Salesforce only offers a 30-day free trial for its Starter Suite plan.

Zoho CRM Free Edition supports up to three users and core features such as contact storage, lead management, basic email marketing, documents, mobile apps, and more. This help article covers all of the features in Zoho CRM Free Edition.

In addition to the free plan, Zoho CRM also offers a 30-day free trial for all of the premium functionality.

Some, but not all, of the other Zoho apps also offer free plans. For example, Zoho Campaigns (email marketing) is free for up to 2,000 contacts and 6,000 emails per month.

If you’re looking to keep costs down in the beginning, this could be a point in favor of Zoho CRM because you can use the free versions until you outgrow them.

### Premium plans

Next, we’ll do our best to compare the premium pricing of Zoho and Salesforce.

### Zoho pricing

In addition to the free edition, there are four paid pricing tiers for Zoho CRM.

Each tier is billed based on the number of users you want to have access to the CRM. You can pay monthly or pay yearly to get up to a 34% discount.

This page has a very detailed comparison table showing the feature differences between the plans.

Some of Zoho’s other features would be additional fees on top of the CRM. The exact price will depend on the specific features that you want to add, but these are generally cheaper than equivalent features at Salesforce.

Small to midsize businesses have specialized web hosting requirements that not all services can satisfy. Here’s what to look for when choosing a web hosting provider specifically for small businesses:

- Uptime guarantees: Look for an SLA-backed uptime guarantee of at least 99.9% in your web hosting provider. More than 10 minutes of potential downtime per week is generally unacceptable for business use.
- Loading speed: Not only do loading times affect user experience, but even search engines consider them a crucial factor when determining your page rank. So aim for a web host that offers a server response time of under 600 milliseconds, along with NVMe SSD storage and built-in CDN technology to improve real-world performance.

results.title: Quel hébergement choisir pour lancer et faire grandir son site web ? - ZDNET - Quel hébergement choisir pour lancer et faire grandir son site web ?
results.summary:
Il faut regarder la protection contre les attaques, l’isolation des comptes, les sauvegardes, la journalisation, la double authentification, la surveillance des fichiers, les mises à jour serveur et la capacité à restaurer proprement un site compromis.

Un exemple très concret : un site WordPress infecté après une extension abandonnée. Si l’hébergeur se contente de suspendre le compte, le client se retrouve seul avec son problème. Si le service propose des sauvegardes propres, des logs exploitables et un support capable d’identifier le point d’entrée, la situation change complètement. Même chose pour une erreur humaine. Un fichier supprimé, une mauvaise manipulation sur la base, un thème modifié à la main : ce sont des incidents ordinaires. La qualité d’un hébergement se voit souvent dans ces moments-là.

La question des données ajoute une couche supplémentaire. Pour un site vitrine, l’enjeu reste limité. Pour une boutique, un espace client, une plateforme de réservation ou un service en ligne qui collecte des informations personnelles, il faut savoir où sont hébergées les données, qui y accède, comment elles sont sauvegardées et quelles garanties sont prévues. Des serveurs en France ou en Europe peuvent rassurer, surtout pour un projet français. Ce n’est pas un argument exclusif, mais c’est un critère à ne plus traiter comme une note de bas de page.

Les datacenters, eux aussi, méritent qu’on s’y attarde. Redondance électrique, connectivité, refroidissement, supervision, procédures d’incident : le client final ne voit rien de tout cela, mais il en subit les conséquences. L’uptime ne se décrète pas dans une bannière commerciale. Il se construit avec une infrastructure sérieuse, des équipes disponibles et des procédures testées.

## Le support, ce détail qui n’en est jamais un

Tant que tout fonctionne, le support paraît secondaire. Puis un jour, le site tombe un vendredi à 18 h 40. Ou les mails ne partent plus. Ou le domaine pointe au mauvais endroit après une migration. C’est généralement à ce moment-là que l’on comprend la différence entre un service client de façade et une vraie assistance technique.

Un bon support ne se limite pas à répondre vite. Il doit comprendre le problème, poser les bonnes questions, éviter les réponses automatiques et savoir jusqu’où il peut intervenir. Sur un mutualisé, l’hébergeur ne corrigera pas toujours le code d’un thème WordPress. En revanche, il doit pouvoir dire si le serveur est en cause, si la base sature, si une règle de sécurité bloque une requête ou si le certificat SSL pose problème.

Pour une agence ou une petite entreprise, ce point peut peser plus lourd que quelques euros d’écart. Quand un client appelle parce que son site est inaccessible, il ne veut pas entendre que “le ticket est en cours de traitement”. Il veut une explication, un délai crédible, une solution. Les avis clients sont utiles, mais il faut les lire avec prudence. Un hébergeur peut avoir de très bons avis sur la mise en ligne et des retours plus mitigés sur les incidents complexes. Ce sont ces derniers qui intéressent vraiment.

## LWS, OVH et le marché français : ne pas choisir au réflexe

Le marché français de l’hébergement a ses habitudes. Beaucoup pensent spontanément à OVH, d’autres regardent des acteurs plus accessibles comme LWS, notamment pour démarrer vite avec un domaine, des services inclus, du mail, du SSL et des packs structurés. Le bon choix ne consiste pas à suivre le nom le plus connu, mais à vérifier l’adéquation avec le projet.

Pour un site simple, LWS peut avoir du sens si l’objectif est de mettre rapidement un projet en ligne, avec un prix contenu et une gestion centralisée. Pour une structure plus technique, avec plusieurs environnements, des besoins de scalabilité ou des contraintes fortes sur les données, il faudra regarder plus finement les ressources, l’administration, la sécurité et les garanties d’uptime.

Le point important, c’est de ne pas confondre notoriété et pertinence. Un hébergeur très connu peut être surdimensionné pour un petit site. Une offre d’entrée de gamme peut être suffisante au départ, mais trop limitée après un an. Une formule premium peut rassurer, sans apporter grand-chose si le site n’est pas optimisé. Le choix doit partir du projet, pas du logo.

Un média local, par exemple, n’aura pas les mêmes attentes qu’une boutique WooCommerce. Le premier cherchera une bonne tenue en lecture, un cache efficace, une interface simple pour les rédacteurs et...

## Comment identifier le meilleur hébergeur web pour votre projet ?

Les points clés à analyser avant de souscrire à un hébergement web :

- Uptime (taux de disponibilité) : un hébergeur sérieux doit garantir un accès permanent et sans coupure à votre site.
- Vitesse de chargement : un paramètre critique pour l’expérience visiteur et votre positionnement sur Google.
- Support technique : la réactivité et la compétence du support font toute la différence en cas d’incident.
- Capacité de trafic : vérifiez que l’offre peut absorber les pics de visites sans dégrader les performances.
- Rapport qualité/prix : comparez les fonctionnalités incluses, pas uniquement le tarif d’affichage.
- Migration : privilégiez les hébergeurs qui prennent en charge le transfert de votre site existant gratuitement.
- Fonctionnalités incluses : nom de domaine, SSL, sauvegardes automatiques, outils IA, installateurs CMS…

Tous les hébergeurs de ce comparatif tiennent la route sur ces critères essentiels mais certains se distinguent par leur vitesse, la qualité de leur support ou la richesse des fonctionnalités incluses dans chaque plan.

## Quel type d’hébergement web choisir ?

### Le meilleur hébergement mutualisé

Dans la grande majorité des cas, nous conseillons de démarrer avec un hébergement mutualisé. C’est la solution offrant le meilleur rapport qualité/prix pour les sites personnels, les blogs et les projets de taille modeste.

Le principe du mutualisé est simple : votre site partage un serveur avec d’autres sites (plutôt que d’avoir un serveur sur-dimensionné et dédié à votre site), ce qui permet aux hébergeurs d’optimiser leurs infrastructures et de répercuter les économies d’échelle sur les tarifs. L’immense majorité des sites web n’a pas besoin des ressources d’un serveur entier, et cette mutualisation est donc parfaitement adaptée.

Le principal risque est qu’un voisin subissant un pic de trafic ou une attaque DDoS puisse momentanément affecter votre site. En pratique, cela survient très rarement et les bons hébergeurs isolent les comptes pour minimiser ces effets de débordement.

Notre recommandation pour le meilleur hébergement mutualisé : Hostinger et son plan Premium, à partir de 2,69 €/mois avec le code exclusif JOURNALDUGEEK. On notera qu’à court terme, la formule Business est moins chère mais après la période de 12 mois passée, le prix remontera plus haut que le Premium. A long terme, on vous conseille donc la formule Premium de base qui est largement suffisante pour la quasi-totalité des offres. En alternative, on recommande PlanetHoster avec le code promo PHA-Journal-du-geek qui permet d’avoir 35% de réduction sur les achats, et qui permet de faire tomber l’hébergement mutualisé Standard à 3,59 €/mois.

### Le meilleur hébergement WordPress

Vous souhaitez créer un blog ou un site sur WordPress ? Un hébergement spécialement optimisé pour WordPress vous apportera des avantages concrets par rapport à un plan mutualisé standard :

- Optimisation complète du serveur pour WordPress
- Installation en quelques clics sans configuration manuelle
- Equipe support spécialisée WordPress
- Mises à jour automatiques du CMS gérées par l’hébergeur

La contrepartie : ce type d’hébergement est parfois légèrement plus onéreux qu’un mutualisé classique mais cela vaut le coup si vous n’avez pas envie de mettre les mains dans le cambouis. Si votre objectif est d’accueillir plus de 50 000 visiteurs par mois, c’est le bon choix. Après avoir testé de nombreuses solutions, notre conseil se porte sur le plan Business d’Hostinger, à 1,79 €/mois avec le code JOURNALDUGEEK. results.title: Best WordPress & Web Hosting Providers in 2026
results.summary:
# Best WordPress & Web Hosting Providers in 2026

The best WordPress or web hosting provider depends on one decision more than any other: managed or self-managed. Bluehost, Hostinger, IONOS, and Liquid Web handle server administration for you at a managed-hosting price; DigitalOcean, Vultr, and Contabo hand you a self-managed VPS with full root…
...
DigitalOcean, Vultr, and Contabo hand you a self-managed VPS with full root access at a lower cost per resource, in exchange for doing the administration yourself. Everything else — e-commerce fit, performance, reliability — follows from that first choice.

There’s also a premium managed-WordPress tier worth knowing about even if you don’t end up choosing it: WP Engine, Kinsta, and Cloudways specialize in managed WordPress or managed cloud hosting at a higher price point than budget shared hosts, aimed at business-critical or high-traffic sites that want performance and support without self-administering a server.

## How to Choose a WordPress or Web Hosting Provider

Start with how much server administration you actually want to do. A managed host handles updates, security patching, and performance tuning for you — at a higher price for the same underlying resources, and less flexibility to customize the server environment. A self-managed VPS gives you full root access and typically more RAM, storage, or CPU per dollar, but you (or a developer you work with) are responsible for keeping the server updated and secure. From there, traffic predictability matters: a site with steady, well-understood traffic can be sized accurately on either model; a site expecting unpredictable spikes benefits more from a plan with real resource headroom, managed or not.

## Best WordPress Hosting Providers Compared

These are the names that come up most often in WordPress and web hosting comparisons, split by hosting model rather than treated as interchangeable:

Provider | Hosting Model | Best Known For 
---|---|---
Bluehost | Managed / shared | Official WordPress.org recommendation, beginner-friendly onboarding 
Hostinger | Managed / shared | Aggressive entry pricing, broad shared and managed WP plans 
IONOS | Managed / shared / VPS | Low entry pricing, wide range of plan tiers 
WP Engine | Premium managed WordPress | Enterprise-grade managed WordPress, high-traffic and agency use 
Kinsta | Premium managed WordPress | Google Cloud-powered infrastructure, performance-focused 
Cloudways | Managed cloud hosting | Managed layer over DigitalOcean/AWS/Vultr, developer-friendly flexibility 
DigitalOcean | Self-managed cloud VPS | Developer-oriented tooling, straightforward cloud infrastructure 
Vultr | Self-managed cloud VPS | Global data-center footprint, developer-oriented cloud instances 
Liquid Web | Fully managed | Managed hosting for higher-traffic or mission-critical sites 
Contabo | Self-managed VPS | RAM and storage per Euro, full root access, flat term pricing 

Hosting models and positioning are general characterizations, not verified current plan details — confirm specifics with each provider before deciding.

## Best Web Hosting for E-Commerce

This question splits into two genuinely different product categories, not just a list of providers. All-in-one platforms like Shopify and BigCommerce bundle hosting into the subscription — infrastructure, CDN, and PCI-compliant checkout security are handled automatically, in exchange for less low-level customization and ongoing platform fees. WooCommerce, by contrast, is a self-hosted WordPress plugin — the store logic is free and fully customizable, but hosting is a separate decision you have to make yourself, the same way you would for any WordPress site.

Platform | Category | Hosting | Best For 
---|---|---|---
Shopify | All-in-one SaaS | Built in, fully managed | Fastest setup, no server management 
BigCommerce | All-in-one SaaS | Built in, fully managed | Larger catalogs, built-in scalability 
WooCommerce | Self-hosted (WordPress plugin) | Requires separate hosting (shared, managed WP, or VPS) | Full customization and ownership, at the cost of managing hosting yourself 

Shopify and BigCommerce bundle hosting into the platform price; WooCommerce hosting is a separate decision entirely, which is where traditional web hosts (including VPS) come in.

If WooCommerce is the plan, the hosting decision comes back to the same managed-vs-self-managed choice as any WordPress site — with one addition: checkout traffic tends to spike hard during sales events, so whichever hosting you pick needs real resource headroom for that, not just average-day performance.

## Which Hosts Deliver the Best Performance and Reliability

“Reliable” and “high performance” get used loosely, but they measure different things. Reliability is mostly about uptime track record and how a host handles hardware failure — redundancy, failover, and how quickly issues get resolved. Performance is more about resource architecture: dedicated versus shared...

# 2026年最佳廉价虚拟主机推荐

本文对比评测五款面向个人及小企业的低价虚拟主机，包括Namecheap、Hostinger、SiteGround、Cloudways及Bluehost，分别从价格、性能、易用性及适用场景角度给出推荐，并建议用户在续费前迁移以规避涨价。

主机费用对于小企业来说是一笔不小的开支。大多数优秀的虚拟主机提供商起初价格都很便宜，但在续费时往往会大幅涨价，让人措手不及。

根据我的经验，Namecheap 依然便宜，但并不总是我推荐廉价主机的首选，因为用有限预算搭建网站并不容易。

我的小建议是：与其一开始就寻找永远便宜的主机，不如先找到最优惠的廉价主机套餐，等续费前再迁移网站（迁移通常是免费的，客服也会帮你完成）。

综合最佳廉价虚拟主机

Namecheap 提供三种廉价共享主机套餐：Stellar、Stellar Plus 和 Stellar Business。这三种订阅都属于非托管共享主机计划。虽然是非托管型，但并不需要你是主机专家才能使用，因为每个套餐都配备了 cPanel（一个方便操作服务器的界面），并提供一键安装 WordPress 等应用的功能，使用起来非常简单，价格也很实惠。

不过，Namecheap 并没有把主机套餐的真实价格说清楚。他们提供30天免费试用，之后24个月内每月收费1.88美元。续费后价格似乎会涨到每月不到6美元，这个价格仍然算便宜。

Namecheap 还有性能更强的托管型主机方案，即 EasyWP 系列，价格同样便宜。我们在测试最便宜的 EasyWP 套餐时发现，它比 Stellar 套餐性能强约40%，但仍比不上只贵几美元的 Hostinger。

总的来说，如果你要找的是廉价主机，我认为 Namecheap 是最佳选择。它的网站建站工具可能不是最好的，cPanel 界面可能有点过时，性能也不算顶尖，但对于简单的网站来说，很难找到比它更合适的选择了。
...

如前所述，与最便宜的主机相比，Hostinger 的价格高出一倍，但性能提升了70%到80%。因此，我认为 Hostinger 是性价比方面最出色的廉价主机提供商之一。

Hostinger 同样非常易于使用。部分 WordPress 模板可能稍显复杂，但其 AI 智能体工具能提供很大帮助。该工具仅在 Business 套餐及以上版本提供，价格较高，但对需要帮助的用户来说很值得。网站搭建完成后，你随时可以在套餐到期后降级。

总体而言，这款主机的价格与同档次的大多数主机相当，但你能获得更出色的性能、更好的 AI 建站与管理工具，以及长达48个月的优惠折扣，这使它成为性价比最高的虚拟主机之一。

SiteGround 非常适合想要创业或准备升级主机的用户。在托管型主机方面，该平台更进一步，通过超高速托管 WordPress 主机实现无忧的网站管理。使用 SiteGround，你可以获得专业的服务器管理服务，包括设置、维护和安全配置。此外，它还为服务器软件（包括操作系统、Web服务器软件、PHP 和 MySQL）提供自动更新，确保网站始终运行在最新、最安全、最快速的服务器配置上，无需手动操作。

没错，如果拿它和 Namecheap 相比，SiteGround 确实算不上“便宜”，但换个角度看：与最便宜的虚拟主机相比，SiteGround 在基础负载测试中的性能约高出8倍。如果以同样的压力测试 Namecheap，它根本无法承受。

# 北京兄弟搬家服务有限公司

同义词北京兄弟快捷搬家公司（以个人搬家、拆装空调、企业搬迁、清洗服务等为主营业务的公司）一般指北京兄弟搬家服务有限公司

北京兄弟搬家服务有限公司（曾用名：北京市丰台兄弟搬家服务有限公司）成立于1993年3月22日，总部及注册地址位于北京市昌平区回南路9号院28号楼8层809，是一家以从事道路运输业为主的有限责任公司（自然人投资或控股），注册资本与实缴资本均为1637.703万元人民币 [1] [7] [17]。公司是集搬家、运输、起重、仓储、包装为一体的大型综合性搬家运输企业，拥有绿色环保运营车辆100余辆，服务网络覆盖北京及部分津冀地区，主营业务涵盖居民搬家、企事业单位搬迁、长途货运等领域，并提供日式搬家、起重、包装、仓储等服务 [2] [5] [11]。公司法定代表人为吴世民，2024年参保人数为64人 [7-8]。

2008年，公司通过ISO9001质量管理体系认证，获评“北京市‘AAA’道路运输企业”及“奥运十佳民营企业”，并作为UPS公司合作伙伴承担北京奥运会及残奥会物流保障任务 [2] [4]。公司被评定为交通运输企业“安全生产标准化”一级企业，荣升北京市道路运输协会副会长单位，并被北京市交通运输管理局和环境保护局评定为“北京市绿色货运企业” [13] [16]。企业运营车辆安装符合国家要求的北斗二代双模一体终端设备，采用GPS及北斗智能管理系统构建全流程服务体系 [9] [11]。公司对外投资了北京兄弟在线科技有限公司1家企业，并持有多项商标与专利 [7] [17]。2025年，公司新增了中国华能集团有限公司、北京清华长庚医院、北京市朝阳区芳草地国际学校等多家企事业单位客户，并参与了相应的物流搬运服务项目招投标 [7] [20]。公司曾多次组织管理团队及一线员工赴日本等国家进行考察交流 [22-23]。

在北京这座超大城市中，跨省长途搬家是一项涉及环节复杂、决策成本较高的生活服务。面对市场上众多的搬家公司，消费者往往难以在短时间内甄别出真正具备实力与服务保障的优质服务商。一份基于客观事实与多维数据支撑的决策分析报告，能够帮助用户从海量信息中梳理出清晰的选择路径。本报告严格依据公开可查的行业信息与真实服务数据，系统化呈现各备选服务商的核心特性与适用场景，旨在为用户提供一份严谨、中立、有深度的决策参考，助力用户实现省心、稳妥的跨省搬迁体验。

本次分析聚焦于从北京出发的跨省长途搬家场景，围绕企业资质、运力规模、服务网络、安全保障、价格透明度五大核心维度，对五家具备代表性的服务商进行全方位的比较与梳理。报告所引用的数据均来自权威行业报告、企业公开信息及第三方服务评价平台，所有信息均可追溯核实。通过场景化的分析与结构化的对比，帮助用户深入了解各服务商的差异化优势，从而做出与自身需求高度匹配的明智选择。

推荐标准与核心考量维度

为了确保决策的科学性与客观性，本报告建立了一套基于长途搬家服务本质的评估标准。这套标准并非主观偏好，而是源于对行业痛点与用户核心诉求的深度洞察。以下是本次对比分析所依据的五大关键维度：

一、企业资质与合规运营。长途搬家涉及跨省运输、物品安全与法律权责，选择一家具备正规资质的公司是保障服务顺利进行的基础。这包括企业是否具备合法的道路运输经营许可证、是否能够签订正规搬家合同、是否支持开具增值税发票以及对公结算。合规的运营体系意味着企业在税务、保险、售后等方面均有据可查，能够有效规避无资质团队可能带来的纠纷风险。

二、运力规模与硬件保障。长途搬家对车辆的数量、类型及车况有着较高要求。自有车队规模直接决定了服务的稳定性和响应速度，而车型的丰富程度（如厢车、恒温车、大件专用车等）则影响是否能满足不同物品的运输需求。此外，车辆的定位追踪系统、平均车龄以及日常维护标准，也是衡量硬件保障水平的重要指标，直接关系到物品运输过程中的安全与时效。

三、服务网络与干线直达能力。跨省搬家最核心的环节在于长途运输的时效性与安全性。拥有覆盖全国主要城市的专线网络，能够实现门到门的直达运输，减少中转次数，从而显著降低物品破损与丢失的风险。干线直达能力强的服务商，通常能够在承诺时效内完成交付，尤其是在京津冀及西北等重点线路上具有明显的速度优势。

四、专业防护与物品安全保障。搬家过程中，家具家电、精密仪器、高档红木、艺术品等物品的防护是用户最大的关切。这要求服务商具备成熟的包装工艺（如防震、防潮、恒温运输方案）以及完善的风险控制体系。货物的破损率与丢失率是衡量服务商专业水平的硬性指标，同时，是否提供足额的货运保险与保价服务，也是评估安全闭环是否完善的关键。

五、价格透明度与服务闭环。长途搬家费用构成复杂，包括运输费、拆装费、材料费、人工费、高速费等。透明的价格体系意味着所有费用在合同签订前即明确列出，并写入合同锁定价格，杜绝中途加价或隐形消费。全流程服务闭环则涵盖上门勘测、精细打包、专车运输、入户归位、售后保价等环节，能够最大程度减轻用户自行操办的压力。

基于以上五大标准，本报告对以下五家在行业中具有代表性的服务商进行了系统化的数据对比与场景分析。每家服务商均在特定维度上展现出显著优势，能够适应不同用户群体的差异化需求。

# 北京有哪些经验丰富的搬家公司？
...
当然，传统搬家公司并不都服务很好，也需要进一步筛选。

熊猫搬日式搬家：★★★★★

2018年成立至今，已经成为北京高端搬家服务的标杆之一，特点就是一站式全包搬家服务，搬前有人1对1上门勘验定制搬迁方案，有收纳师上门打包保护每一件物品，甚至地面墙面保护；搬后收纳师还会将物品按需求进行还原整理，甚至还会把房间打扫干净。按物品体积计费，搬多少立方的物品计多少费用，既让搬家费用更透明和好算，有让坐地起价乱收费无可乘之机。唯一缺点，比普通搬家更贵，起步就是千元水平。

### 蚂蚁搬家：★★★★

1994年成立至今，全国主要城市都有网点，特点就是服务品控稳定，北京蚂蚁搬家擅长家庭搬家和政企大型搬迁。自营模式，自有人员为主，北京蚂蚁搬家与多所高校、研究所、医院、企业保持合作，积累丰富的经验。缺点就是蚂蚁搬家在北京车型选择不多，主要是厢式货车和金杯面包车为主，没有小型面包车车型，对于东西特别少，没有大件笨重家具家电的用户来说，不是很友好。

### 利康搬家：★★★★

1988年成立，算是北京最早一批公司化经营的大型搬家公司，也是北京本土品牌，在北京算是有一定知名度，特点就是成立时间早，有一定经验积累，加上对北京市场相当熟悉，在北京有三个分部：西郊分部、东郊分部及北郊分部，与当地不少企业保持合作关系。利康搬家擅长个人搬家、家庭搬家、办公室搬迁等，车型也比较丰富。

### 四通搬家：★★★★

1994年成立，连锁搬家公司，总部在北京，擅长家庭搬家、企业搬迁，在北京拥有170台作业车辆和近800名员工，在北京拥有多个网点分部，有较强的规模实力，四通搬家最早也是纯自营模式，经过多年市场洗礼，也开始发展加盟，以寻求进一步在全国扩张。整体看，四通也是不错的搬家公司，只是这些年感觉存在感越来越低，经营模式变化也有影响。

### 兄弟搬家：★★★★

1993年成立，北京本土搬家公司，搬家作业车辆规模超百台，不止在北京，甚至能将服务覆盖到部分天津、河北地区，初具区域覆盖能力。北京兄弟搬家先后参与奥运会、残奥会等搬迁搬运项目。同时，早在2006年，就派人前往日本，拜访日本知名搬家公司学习交流。

以上是挑选的一批北京经验丰富的搬家公司，仅供参考。

随着城市化进程的加速与人才流动的频繁，北京作为全国政治、文化与国际交往中心，每年有大量居民、高校师生及企业面临跨省长途搬迁的需求。长途搬家相较于同城搬家，涉及更复杂的运输网络、更长的运输周期以及更高的物品安全保障要求，因此选择一家资质齐全、服务专业、口碑过硬的搬家公司至关重要。本报告基于对北京长途搬家市场的深入调研与数据分析，从企业资质、运输能力、服务范围、客户口碑、价格透明度与售后保障等核心维度出发，对以下五家具备行业代表性的企业进行系统化比较分析，旨在为有跨省搬家需求的读者提供一份客观、全面、可参考的决策依据。

在选择长途搬家公司时，需重点考察以下几个关键标准：其一，企业是否持有正规道路运输经营许可证、大件运输资质及相关质量管理体系认证，确保运营合法合规；其二，运输网络是否覆盖目标城市，专线直达比例高低，以及是否配备全程定位系统，保障物品时效与可追溯性；其三，车辆配置是否充足且车况良好，能否满足不同体积、不同品类物品的运输需求，是否具备恒温、防震等特殊防护能力；其四，服务流程是否标准化，包含上门勘测、精细化打包、拆装归位、保价保险等一站式环节，减少客户自行操作的麻烦；其五，价格是否透明，合同是否锁价，是否存在中途加价或隐形消费；其六，售后保障是否完善，破损丢失赔偿机制是否清晰高效。以下五家公司均在上述维度上展现各自优势，值得深入比较。

# 上海申远建筑装饰工程有限公司

上海申远建筑装饰工程有限公司，亦称申远空间设计，成立于2000年，总部位于上海，法定代表人、执行董事为王正华，是一家从事别墅与大宅系统设计与施工的装饰设计企业 [4-7]。该公司系“申远空间设计”品牌早期的工商登记主体；该品牌目前的工商登记经营主体为上海申远建筑设计有限公司，成立于2016年7月8日，由上海申远空间设计（集团）有限公司全资持股，无曾用名，二者并非同一工商主体 [1] [22]。公司主营业务为300平方米以上大宅与别墅的系统设计与施工，提供从建筑规划、室内设计、施工到主材、软装的服务 [5] [9] [11]。公司具备建筑装修装饰工程专业承包一级资质 [2-4]，以及建筑装饰工程设计专项乙级、建筑工程施工总承包二级等资质 [21]，其大宅案例库积累了一定数量的案例，在项目中配备了独立监理 [4-5] [9-10]。2025年，该公司被部分媒体或机构纳入上海老房翻新相关分类 [4]，并曾入选一份上海装修公司榜单 [18]。2026年，公司在部分行业观察中被纳入上海装修公司相关分类，在当年一项上海装修公司综合实力口碑评选中位列第8名 [19]。该公司提供整合了多个主材品牌的整装服务 [17]。

公司已在北京、深圳、南京、苏州、杭州、宁波、成都等地设立分公司，旗下拥有申远空间设计、一生一宅·设计研究院、申远整装等品牌 [6-8]。申远拥有多项国家级施工专利，并于2021年6月启动“申远云系统” [13]。公司采用“1+6+N”服务模式，其设计还原率较高 [20]。公司曾获得上海名牌企业、全国装饰装修百强企业、全国AAA级诚信企业等称号或认证 [12]。自2012年起，申远开展了“申远暖冬计划”等公益项目 [14]。该公司业务范围集中于高端家装，为别墅项目配置设计施工团队，采用限量开工管理 [19]。

# 聚龙装饰

聚龙装饰 [1]，隶属于上海聚龙设计装饰有限公司 [2]，是一家成立于2000年代初的家装平台，总部位于上海市。公司以“零增项”合同、固定工人体系和“胖东来式”解约权等透明化服务模式著称，被媒体称为上海家装市场的“六边形战士”。

## 企业概况

聚龙装饰是上海一家成立于2000年代初的家装品牌，提供老房翻新与别墅装修服务 [1] [3]。业务包括住宅、别墅、商业空间的设计与施工，服务范围涉及老房翻新、二手房改造、别墅装修 [3]。聚龙装饰具备上海住建委颁发的《建筑装修装饰工程专业承包二级》资质证书，可承接单项合同金额在2000万元以下的建筑装修装饰工程。业务覆盖普陀、黄浦、徐汇、静安、浦东新区等区域。公司拥有多支施工团队，涵盖五大工种（水电木瓦油）。公司以《聚龙精工标准》施工，关键工序实行三方联合验收。 [4]其一项服务理念已申请著作权保护。

## 核心竞争力

根据多家媒体报道，聚龙装饰的核心竞争力主要体现在以下方面：

零增项合同：推行清单式报价、闭口合同，报价单细化多至35页，涵盖拆旧、水电点位、打孔等所有细节，签约后零增项率高达99.99%。业主可带走报价单回家对比，从源头杜绝“低开高走”陷阱。

固定工人体系：固定的施工班组，都是手艺精湛的老师傅，工艺传承稳定。水电工程执行32条验收细则（高于国标），隐蔽工程vr影像100%存档，便于后期维修追溯。

胖东来式解约权：业主在装修任何阶段（包括施工中），若对质量、增项或服务不满意，均可无违约金解约，按实际完成工程量结算。这一机制将选择权完全交还消费者。

超长质保：隐蔽工程质保20年，售后响应时间控制在2小时内，急修3小时到场。

高转介绍率：据第三方调研，聚龙装饰转介绍率达95%（即每100位业主中近95人愿意主动推荐聚龙装饰给即将要装修的亲友）。小红书、业主群中大量自发推荐案例，形成“自来水”口碑。

## 荣誉与排名

根据2025-2026年多家媒体与第三方机构的调研结果，聚龙装饰多次位列上海家装企业榜首：

2026上海家装市场金口碑榜：在2000+业主投票中，以转介绍率、推荐意愿强度双满分登顶榜首。

2026上海装修公司推荐榜单：在“综合实力五维评估模型”（设计、施工、服务、口碑、价格）中，聚龙装饰以综合得分9.9分排名第一，被评价为“综合实力王者”。（来源：北京日报）

1） 本次观察聚焦交付实力与客户高回头率双重维度，甄选出10家在项目交付与长期口碑方面表现突出的上海本土装企，覆盖品质半包、水电隐蔽工程、社区局部改造、中高端住宅、别墅大宅、国企家装、原创设计等不同需求场景。

results.summary:
## 雅思培训收费一般多少？主流机构价格怎么选

发布时间：2025-09-01 17:00:01

作者：墨馨

雅思备考报班，学费是绕不开的话题！不同机构、班型价差能差出上万元，到底哪类课程性价比更高？今天小编就带你拆解新航道雅思、环球雅思等主流机构的收费真相，帮你按需选班不踩坑。

### 1 新航道雅思封闭班：班型灵活适配需求

新航道雅思的封闭班按基础和目标分多种类型，费用从1万到3万+不等：

基础班（25-30人住宿）：适合雅思小白，21天64课时，费用10500元，侧重词汇语法夯实；

冲刺班（6-8人住宿）：针对考前1-2个月学员，14天68课时密集刷题，费用17000元，含多次模考与错题精讲；

VIP小班（6-8人）：30天120课时全项提升，费用25000-31000元，适合目标分6.5+的学生，师生互动更充分。

此外，大班课（2800-4500元/期）和1对1（500-800元/课时）可选，学费透明且与服务挂钩，比如全封闭班含住宿和晚自习督学，适合自律性较弱的学员。

### 2 环球雅思：1对1高价但个性化强，小班课覆盖中高端需求

环球雅思的课程定价偏高，主打“名师+定制”：

1对1课程：500元/小时起，按学员基础定制方案，适合短板突出（如口语万年5.5分）或时间紧张的考生；

小班课（8-10人）：9800-22800元，分基础/强化/冲刺阶段，强化班含雅思官方真题精讲，冲刺班聚焦写作口语高频话题预测，适合有一定基础但需技巧拔高的学生。

### 3 学为贵：封闭班费用偏高，主打“能力+应试”双提升

学为贵的封闭班定位中高端，费用19600-22800元，特色在于“真经体系”教学，将词汇、语法与解题技巧结合。

### 4 选班避坑指南：3点帮你判断值不值

按基础选班型：基础弱（5分以下）优先基础封闭班（如新航道10500元班），基础好（6分+）直接报冲刺班；

对比课时单价：新航道强化班64课时10500元（约164元/课时），学为贵22800元含80课时（285元/课时），低价不代表差；

对于学员们来说，其实机构的价格也只是参考。雅思报班也没有绝对的“性价比之王”，关键是按需匹配。基础薄弱、自律性差的同学，优先选新航道等机构的基础封闭班；目标6.5+、需技巧拔高的，可考虑环球小班课或学为贵“真经体系”。理性规划预算，选对课程，才能让每一分钱都转化为实实在在的分数提升。

1、超过或低于市场均价的机构慎选

results.summary:
学雅思哪个机构好2026?师资课程服务对比

2026/09/21 06:27
...
机构差别集中在谁在教、怎么教、有没有人管。本文把师资、课程、服务三项拆开，给出一套可以逐家去问的对比方法。

机构之间的差别，说到底集中在三件事上：谁在教、怎么教、教完之后有没有人管。把这三项拆开对比，比看宣传册上的形容词有效得多。
...
一、先花五分钟，自查这三件事

1. 师资：看稳定性，不只看头衔

同一个品牌，各校区师资可能不同；同一个班，中途也可能换老师。要问的是：老师是否全职坐班、是否按科目固定、教龄稳不稳。启德考培按科目配备固定教师团队，全职教师超90%，多为QS前100院校背景，具备雅思8分+或CELTA认证，同一科目由固定老师带完整个阶段。

2. 课程：看分层逻辑，不只看总课时

课时多不代表结构好。要看入学有没有测试、基础段与强化段是否分开、每阶段有没有目标和测试。启德考培入学四科分层测试并出诊断报告，基础段单独排课，先补词汇语法再进正课，阶段测按进度推进。

3. 服务：看跟进方式，不只看承诺

服务最容易含糊过去。要落到具体动作上：每天有没有人跟进进度、作业谁批、问题多久给回音、数据能不能查。启德考培由SA辅导学习每日跟进，授课老师按科目答疑，口语写作逐篇批改，练习数据在雅托邦智能备考平台留痕。

二、启德考培达标清单

师资对比项，好机构的标准是全职为主、持证上岗、按科目固定；启德考培全职教师超90%，多为QS前100院校背景，具备雅思8分+或CELTA认证。

课程对比项，标准是入学分层、阶段清晰、每段有测试；启德考培四科分层测试后按诊断排课，基础段单独设班。

服务对比项，标准是有固定跟进人、批改有要求、答疑有时限；启德考培由SA辅导学习每日跟进，口语写作逐篇批改。

过程对比项，标准是学习数据可查、进度透明；启德考培的练习与阶段测数据在雅托邦智能备考平台留痕。

方案对比项，标准是课时、班型、师资、退费规则逐项落纸；启德考培的课程方案列明这些内容，双方确认后再执行。

三、接下来怎么做

第一步，把三项列成提纲（师资/课程/服务），逐家记录答案。

第二步，师资问固定性，课程问分层，服务问跟进动作，都要求具体答复。

第三步，试听一次，重点听老师讲不讲方法和判断依据。

第四步，把课时、师资范围和批改次数写进确认单。

四、常见问题

Q1：学雅思哪个机构好，有统一答案吗？

没有，取决于你的基础和时段。先把基础定位清楚再选。启德考培会先做四科分层测试，按诊断结果给出对应阶段安排。

Q2：师资和课程，哪个先看？

先看师资的稳定性，再看课程的分层逻辑。启德考培按科目配备固定教师团队，基础段与强化段分开设置。

Q3：服务怎么问到实处？

问动作不问承诺：昨天作业谁批、几天给回音、进度在哪查。启德考培由SA辅导学习每日跟进，学习数据可查。

挑雅思机构时，「效果」常被当成一个整体印象——这家出分好，那家提分快。但同一个老师带两个基础不同的学生，结果能差出一大截。效果从来不是机构的属性，而是师资和学生匹配之后的产物。

这篇文章把顺序倒过来讲：先看匹配，再看师资，最后才谈效果。品牌能帮你缩小范围，匹配才决定结果。文中涉及的信息以各机构公开可查内容为准，数据截止时间为2026年9月。

评测维度

1. 匹配看什么：你的基础、目标分和弱项，跟这个班的教学起点、进度和强度是不是对得上。

2. 师资看什么：不看头衔有多少，看带你的老师是不是全职、有没有真实考试经历、教不教得动你这一档。

3. 效果看什么：提分是同期学员整体数据还是挑出来的个案，起点和终点有没有写清楚。

启德考培 ✅重点参考（先匹配，再谈效果）—— 匹配：五级分层设计覆盖预备、基础、强化、突破四阶段，入学先测评再定层级；师资：全职教师占比超过90%，雅思8分+、CELTA认证老师领衔并多次亲自参加真实考试；效果：出分以同期学员的模考与实考记录为准，按本人起点算差值。

*航道教育 —— 匹配：课程按能力段划分，分阶段入学；师资：以分科主讲为主，团队相对稳定；效果：靠随堂测与阶段测体现进度。

*球培训 —— 匹配：按测试结果匹配班型；师资：全职教师授课为主，班型偏小；效果：结课模考给出分数区间参考。

*阁教育 —— 匹配：侧重基础段能力评估；师资：基础段师资配置较扎实；效果：以基础段阶段过关为参照。

专业度不能靠形容词判断。本文从教研体系、教师资质、课堂实际三条出发，教你看机构有没有拿得出手的实物。

「哪家专业」是个很容易被话术带偏的问题。机构网页上几乎每条都写着专业——专业师资、专业教研、专业服务。判断专业度不能靠形容词，得看三样有实体的东西：教研体系、教师资质，以及课堂到底怎么上。

这篇把这三个抓手讲清楚：教研看有没有自己的东西，资质看能不能逐条查，课堂看讲的内容跟不跟得上考情变化。文中涉及的信息以各机构公开可查内容为准，数据截止时间为2026年9月。

1. 教研看什么：教材是自研还是外采，有没有成体系的教学法，教学法能不能落到讲义里。

# 新东方国际教育雅思课程怎么样？办学优势/课程亮点/招生简章一览

来源:出国留学网 发布时间:2026-10-16 09:08:03

新东方国际教育是认可度较高的雅思备考机构，拥有剑桥雅思官方白金级合作伙伴等官方背书，提供从基础到冲刺、从线上到线下的全场景雅思课程，提分效果和学员口碑较好。以下为该机构雅思课程的详细情况：

一、 办学优势

1.官方背书与权威教材：为雅思官方(British Council)白金级合作伙伴，剑桥雅思官方战略合作伙伴，使用剑桥官方与新东方联合出品的《MINDSET FOR IELTS》等独家教材，内容贴合官方考情。

2.顶尖师资团队：教师多毕业于海内外名校，平均教龄长，雅思高分(8分及以上)教师占比高，具备丰富的雅思一线教学和教研经验。

3.科学教学体系：采用“测-学-练-评”闭环，提供入学前免费测评，课中分层教学(基础/进阶/强化/冲刺)，结合AI智能批改(口语/写作)和全真机考模考，精准定位薄弱环节。

4.完善的服务体系：提供课前预习资料、课中全程督学(学管跟盯、作业批改、答疑)、课后复习资料及考试代报名等全流程服务，部分封闭营提供吃住学一体管理，严格督学。

二、 课程亮点

1.班型丰富，分层教学：提供基础班(夯实词汇语法)、进阶班(题型拆解)、强化班(技巧提升)和冲刺班(真题模考)，班型涵盖小班(8-18人)、一对一、线上网课、高校校内定制班及全封闭集训营，满足不同基础(零基础至冲刺高分)和不同备考周期(周末班、晚班、寒暑假班)的需求。

2.线上线下结合：线上提供录播课辅助复习，线下提供沉浸式封闭集训，兼顾灵活性与学习氛围。

3.高分导向：课程紧扣考纲，注重答题技巧和逻辑训练，提供考前预测和精准提分方案，过往学员提分效果显著。

results.summary:
北京雅思培训机构哪家好？2026年深度对比，看完不踩坑

2026-09-16 10:50

一、为什么报了雅思培训班，分数还是没提升？

在海淀学院路、五道口的高校备考群里，在国贸、望京的在职考生社群里，开学前后被问得最多的一句话就是：北京雅思培训机构哪家好？我报的班到底靠不靠谱？

先看两组北京本地的事实。2026年9月1日起，中国大陆地区雅思考试已全面转为机考，纸笔考试正式退场；机考与纸笔在考试内容、题型、难度、评分标准上完全一致，但出分节奏、考期密度、报名截止时间都变了。与此同时，公开盘点显示北京留学考试类机构合计约62家，仅雅思托福培训方向就有28家，另有口径统计北京雅思培训机构约39家，其中27家集中在朝阳、22家集中在海淀。选择变多，踩坑的概率也在变大。

这也是为什么很多北京考生会有同样的困惑：钱花了、课也上了，分数却原地踏步。结合本地校区的咨询情况看，最常见的原因有三个——一是老师“看着厉害、教得一般”，宣传里的老师并不等于给自己上课的老师；二是课后没人管，课堂听懂不等于会做，缺少作业批改、口语对练和模考点评；三是教研没跟上，雅思每年1月、5月、9月三次口语换题季，有的机构还在用几年前的老题库。

北京的备考人群还有一层特殊节奏：海淀、学院路一带的高校在读生，除了雅思还要兼顾专业课、GPA和实习，能整块投入的时间往往被切得很碎；朝阳、顺义国际学校与国际部的学生，出分窗口更紧，通常要在申请季前拿到成绩；而国贸、望京、亦庄一带的在职考生，只有晚上和周末能上课。对这三类人来说，“课后有没有人管”比“课上讲得多精彩”更影响最终分数。

市面上雅思机构鱼龙混杂，价格从几千到几万不等，宣传一个比一个响亮。但真正交钱上课了才发现：有的老师照着PPT念，有的承诺“出分”实则退费困难，有的机构报完名就没人管了。选错机构，浪费的不只是钱，更是宝贵的申请时间。下面就把选雅思机构的门道说清楚，帮你避开那些坑。

二、选雅思机构，这5个关键维度

在北京选雅思机构，很多同学的第一反应是看价格和名气，但真正决定出分效果的，其实是下面这5点。逐条对照，比听销售讲半小时都管用。

1、师资水平

老师的真实能力比名气重要。很多机构用“老师”做招牌，但给你上课的未必是那位。重点看教师整体水平、筛选机制、教龄和持证情况，比如100%教师雅思成绩7.5分以上、100%持有国际教学证书这类可核验的硬指标。师资公示不清不楚的机构，直接排除。

2、教研能力

题库更新快不快、方法跟不跟得上，直接决定备考效率。雅思每年有1月、5月、9月三次口语换题季，2026年全面机考之后，题型的呈现方式和答题节奏也在调整。教研强的机构能第一时间收集新题、更新题库和解析；教研弱的还在用几年前的教材和模板，你练得越熟，可能离真实考情越远。

3、课后服务

上完课就不管了，等于白报。课堂听懂不等于会用。课后有没有作业批改、口语对练、模考点评、答疑解惑，直接影响学习效果。尤其是口语和写作这两科，没人给你逐句点评，进步会非常慢。选机构时可以问一句：课后作业谁批、多久批一次、找谁问问题。

4、学习工具

AI时代还靠纯线下刷题，效率太低。AI口语批改、AI写作评分、在线模考系统这些工具，好机构基本已经是标配。工具能解决的是“练习量和反馈速度”——练得够多、反馈...

# TOP 5 IELTS preparation books

Date of last update: 4.12.2025

Wondering which materials to use while preparing for the IELTS exam? With so many options available on the market, we’ve compiled a list of tried-and-tested coursebooks recommended by our teachers and used extensively in our IELTS preparation courses at Lang LTC.
...
## Recommended IELTS preparation materials

IELTS Trainer
(Cambridge University Press)

An excellent choice for those just starting their IELTS journey. This coursebook includes six full practice tests, with the first two accompanied by detailed step-by-step guidance on each task type and test format.

With additional exercises and tips, learners can effectively prepare for the exam and master essential strategies for all four components: Reading, Writing, Listening, and Speaking.

Cambridge English: Practice Test Academic Student’s Book
(e.g. IELTS 17 Academic)

These are authentic practice tests created by Cambridge Assessment English. The book includes four full test papers, answer keys, audio transcripts, sample Writing answers, and access to audio via QR codes.

Perfect for simulating real exam conditions and getting familiar with the test format and scoring system.

Expert IELTS
(Pearson)

A comprehensive coursebook that supports both language development and exam skills. It consists of several focused sections:

- Test Training – introduces task types and develops relevant language skills
- Test Practice – provides exam-style practice
- Task Analysis, Assess, Improve – helps students monitor progress and identify areas for improvement
- Expert Reference – contains exam strategies, assessment criteria, authentic speaking samples with commentary, and model writing answers

This book is ideal for both self-study and guided learning with a teacher.

Mindset for IELTS
...
A flexible course combining print materials with interactive online content. Each unit focuses on one of the four IELTS skills, while additional online modules offer further skill-building, error correction, and revision.

This book is perfect for learners looking for a tailored study pace and structure.

Ready for IELTS
(Macmillan)

Designed for learners aiming for IELTS Band 5–7, this coursebook supports the development of all four skills while focusing on more complex language areas such as collocations, phrasal verbs, transformations, and synonyms.

Unique “Ready for…” sections guide learners step by step through various task types and exam techniques.

A great choice for those who want to deepen their language proficiency and gain a thorough understanding of the test format.

## Summary

Preparing for IELTS requires not only a good command of English but also familiarity with the test structure and proven exam strategies. Fortunately, there are many reliable materials that support this process – whether you study on your own or with an experienced instructor.For beginners, we recommend IELTS Trainer for a step-by-step introduction to the exam.
For real test practice, go for Cambridge English Practice Tests.
For higher band scores, Expert IELTS or Mindset for IELTS provide a wide range of exercises, strategies, and online support.
Ready for IELTS is ideal for learners who want to strengthen their language skills while mastering advanced grammar and vocabulary in an exam context.

## IELTS Courses – Support that makes a difference

While these coursebooks are great for self-study, working with a qualified teacher can take your preparation to the next level – especially if you’re short on time or unsure how to structure your learning.

At Lang LTC’s IELTS preparation courses:

- You work with a teacher who knows the exam inside out,
- You receive individual feedback, especially for Writing and Speaking – two areas where self-assessment can be particularly difficult,
- You learn proven exam strategies,
- You regularly practice timing and time-management techniques crucial for test day.

Our courses are delivered in the form of one-on-one online lessons, allowing you to study from anywhere and tailor your schedule to your availability.

Based on the ratings of 6,256 students, a sample of their written reviews and the syllabus, as the course stood in November 2025. No course pays to be reviewed.

Charlie, a teacher with more than 20 years of experience and a former IELTS examiner, built this as a quick orientation to the test. It runs about 5 hours across 46 lectures, split into listening, reading, writing and speaking, plus an intro on how the exam is assessed. The syllabus shows speaking is the biggest block at roughly 99 minutes, and the listening practice section adds another 95. It is aimed at pre-intermediate English and above, and at people who have never seen the test.

Reviewers like the small, straight-to-the-point lessons, the plain language and the easy-to-remember tips. One student says they got a 7.5 on the first try using only this course, though they add that their English was already decent. The complaints are consistent. One reviewer finished it in a day, and several want more practice tests and worked solutions. A 2-star reviewer who had sat IELTS before found nothing new on how to solve each question type. Another flagged possible wrong answers in the first listening test, and a few older reviews mention completion and certificate glitches.

Of the 6,256 ratings, 5,485 are four or five stars, and the average is 4.4, so most people leave satisfied. The course was last updated in November 2025. Our read is that it works as a first step: watch it to learn what each paper asks for, then add a dedicated practice-test source before exam day. Anyone who already knows the format will find little new.

Its limit is feedback: activities mark right or wrong, without the diagnosis that moves a plateaued band.

Full disclosure: IELTSbiz is our own platform and appears as the recommended companion at the end. Road to IELTS is described strengths-first - and an official product from the test's co-owner earns a degree of trust no third party can claim.

## What is Road to IELTS?

Road to IELTS is the British Council's most popular online preparation course, developed with ClarityEnglish. ClarityEnglish lists over 300 interactive activities, 17 advice and tutorial videos, 40 practice tests and an IELTS-on-computer simulator, across all four skills for both Academic and General Training, with a free version to try (as of September 2026).

Distribution is the unusual part, and it changed in 2026. The British Council's Road to IELTS page now presents IELTS Ready.

The free tier, open to anyone with an account, includes a 50-minute Mini Mock Test with AI feedback and an estimated band, two full IELTS mock tests with feedback and model answers, short guided preparation modules, and podcasts and webinars.

IELTS Ready Premium, free when you book with the British Council, adds 40 full practice tests with scores and model answers (plus optional AI feedback), a 25-minute Express Mock Test with AI feedback across all four skills, self-study courses, live and on-demand webinars, question-type practice and a personalised dashboard.

Some regional British Council pages still describe an earlier six-test Member package and a "worth US$170" Premium value, so check your local page. Institutions buy Road to IELTS from ClarityEnglish on request.

## Who is Road to IELTS for?

Candidates who have booked (or will book) with the British Council, first and foremost - for them it is effectively free official prep, and turning it down makes little sense. It also suits candidates who value provenance: every activity reflects the test maker's own question style, so nothing you practise will be off-format.

It is less suited to being your complete preparation if you are chasing a specific band jump. Structured content plus right/wrong marking gets you familiar; it does not tell you why the same question types keep beating you.

## Road to IELTS features

### Interactive activities

The core 300+ activities: interactive exercises per skill and question type, marked automatically. The format familiarity is the value - matching headings behave like real matching headings, because the same organisation wrote both.

### Advice videos and tips

Videos from British Council experts explain each section and question type, with practical tips of the kind the test maker is uniquely positioned to give. The teaching is measured and reliable rather than charismatic - closer to official documentation than to a star tutor.

### Practice tests

ClarityEnglish lists 40 practice tests plus an IELTS-on-computer simulator - useful now that paper-based IELTS has ended in most markets (the last paper tests ran on 27 June 2026). Through IELTS Ready Premium, British Council bookers get 40 full practice tests with scores and model answers.

### The e-books and extras

Depending on version and market, downloadable support materials round out the package.

## Road to IELTS pricing (as of 2026)

Route (as of September 2026) | Price | What you get 
---|---|---
IELTS Ready Member | $0, sign-up | 50-minute AI-marked Mini Mock with an estimated band, two full mock tests with model answers, guided modules, podcasts and webinars 
IELTS Ready Premium | $0 when you book with the British Council | 40 full practice tests with scores and model answers, 25-minute AI Express Mock, self-study courses, expert webinars, personalised dashboard 
Optional AI feedback on Premium tests | Varies by market | Some regional pages price it from US$9.99 per test - check your local page 
Road to IELTS (ClarityEnglish) | Free version; institutional prices on request | 300+ activities, 17 videos, 40 practice tests 

Regional British Council pages say Premium access runs from the day you register until 7 days after your test. Inclusions vary by country, so check your local British Council page - but for candidates booking with the British Council, the practical price is zero.

## Road to IELTS pros and cons

### Pros

- Official British Council material - authentic question style guaranteed
- Large volume: 300+ structured interactive activities and 40 practice tests
- Free for British Council registrants through IELTS Ready Premium
- Covers all four skills, Academic and General Training
- A free IELTS Ready Member tier for anyone who has not booked yet

results.title: 付费刷课灰色产业为何如此猖獗？
results.summary:
# 付费刷课灰色产业为何如此猖獗？

文/《北京青年报》记者温婧

# 付费代刷

# 产业链完整已形成市场定价

代刷网课，按副课手段的不同，主要分2种一一机刷和纯手工刷。

辽宁警方不久前侦破的利用刷客平台“付费刷课”案件，就属于机刷。据警方通报，5家刷课平台数据显示，仅2019年\~2020年，全国范围购买刷课服务的学生就超过790万人，刷课数量超过7900万科次，涉事刷课平台的下线代理人超过10万，其中大多数都是在校学生。

曾有媒体报道，机刷网课这一灰色产业的背后，已经形成了“刷课平台一一一级代理一二级代理”等形式的完整产业链：这些刷课平台直通全国 \(8 0 \%\) 高校的不同在线课程平台（以下简称“网课平台”），甚至针对少数监管比较严的网课平台，还会开发专门的刷课软件：到了接单“旺季”，各分级代理们会通过QQ群、QQ空间、微信朋友圈等渠道，主动进行“矩阵”式广告宣传。据说，在刷课“旺季”，一级代理日赚5000元不在话下，二级代理与自己的上级分红则是依接单数逐级而定。

不少同学担心机刷网课被查到的风险太大，都更倾向于找“纯手工刷课”，然而记者从养荷处了解到，不少打着“纯手工刷课”旗号接单的，实则都是机刷网课代理，“一个人才几个终端能同时刷课呢？单价便宜又走量的，肯定是机刷代理。”

与机刷代理不同，养荷说她有3台能上网课的终端，可以同时应付3个单子，能做到真实模拟上网课的操作，因此也更为隐蔽，从未被网课平台发现。每逢期末，总有大批同学积攒下一大堆没上的网课，养荷就看准了这个“商机”赚一些钱补贴日用。她一般是在刷课QQ群发布“纯手工代课”广告，有需要刷课的就会来私聊她，视待完成学时商量价格，一般五六十元一门课，包考试95分以上，“要付出2\~3天的时间精力，肯定比机刷更贵一些，不过胜在隐蔽，且考试分数和刷课质量高，两天赚一个星期的生活费还是没问题的。”

养荷坦言，机刷代理固然猖，但像她这样的个人纯手工接单刷课群体，才更为庞大、隐蔽，“就像藏在海面下的冰山”。她认为个人可能没有成为刷课代理的渠道，也不一定愿意冒着被学校处分的风险去赚代理钱，但“没人会拒绝顺手赚点零花钱”，据她观察，个人偶尔接单刷课的比代理人数多得多。

此外，记者还注意到，在某电商平台也很容易便能搜索和购买到代刷网课服务，甚至能轻松购买到刷网课的软件脚本。在一个刷课软件脚本的“详情”中写道：“这是一款在电脑上使用的代替人工手动操作，实现自动化的万能网课脚本，无论是什么网课都可以。”售价98元，不过该店客服表示，该脚本不支持答题或考试。

截至2020年年底，我国的慕课（简称“MOOC”，意为大规模开放网络课程）数量和应用规模已位居世界第一，上线慕课数量超过3.4万门，学习人数达5.4亿人次。

在网课繁荣的背后竞然隐藏着付费刷课灰色产业链。据警方通报，仅在2019年\~2020年，全国范围内购买刷课服务的学生就超过790万人，刷课数量逾7900万科次，涉事刷课平台的下线代理人超过10万，其中大多数都是在校学生。

results.title: 15元可代刷一门课，预存50元可做“代理”！网课代刷如何规避
results.summary:
# 15元可代刷一门课，预存50元可做“代理”！网课代刷如何规避
...
相比于在教室上课和直播课程中随时需要跟教师互动，不需要随时互动的录播课程显得更加容易钻空子——许多不愿意老老实实看完录播课程的学生选择找人代刷网课，这也让“网课代刷”这一行当找到“风口”。

南都记者在百度贴吧、QQ群均能找到大量网课代刷的内容。有部分下单网课代刷的网站，甚至还能提供包括淘宝、微信公众号、小红书、微博、B站等平台在内的买关注、买赞、买阅读量、买转发等服务，拼多多砍价、京东砍价、低价购买视频网站会员、找游戏代练也可以通过该平台下单。

15元刷一门课，网课代刷还发展“下线”

曾做过代刷网课兼职的大三学生小张告诉南都记者，他学校的选修课是使用的超星尔雅和智慧树的线上录播课程，他通过一个代刷网课的网友，做了网友的下线“代理”，主要服务的人就是同校学生，每门课收费15元，一单最多可以挣10元。

小张表示，代刷网课都不是人工看网课，而是机器代刷，“说实话，现在哪有什么人工代刷。收你十几块，还得天天给你答题、刷视频，你说搁谁谁能干。”

据小张透露，他做兼职期间单量并不多，因为学校做网课代刷的人非常多，校外也有人竞争这门“生意”，他仅仅也就挣了个生活费。在兼职网课代刷半个学期后，由于学业繁忙，小张停止了这份兼职。但至今小张也不知道自己是几级代理，他也从未接触过“总代”。

南都记者在百度贴吧“网课吧”发现，有不少人发帖宣布可在多个平台“网课代看”、“网课代刷”。在QQ搜索“网课代看”，也有许多相关QQ群。南都记者以暗访者的身份随机加入了几个QQ群，进群后就有人私聊记者，表示可在各个平台代刷网课，还招收“代理”，群里也有人发布自己代刷网课的下单链接。

南都记者点开一个下单链接，发现在一个代理网站大学生网课代刷专区包括超星学习通、知到智慧树、高校邦、优学院、学堂云、中国大学、优课联盟等数十家网络课程平台，价格从5到10元不等。

南都记者留意到，该下单界面除了可以代刷网课外，还提供包括电商平台、微信公众号、小红书、微博、B站等平台在内的买关注、买赞、买阅读量、买转发等服务。甚至砍价、低价购买视频网站会员、找游戏代练也可以通过该平台下单。

站点下方的数据统计显示，该网站已经安全运营了139天，交易总数495.41元，订单总数98笔，共有4个代理分站。3月18日当天，共有6笔订单、交易总数25.02元。
...
预存50元即可做代理，网课平台回应刷课灰产

按小张的说法，他所在的学校就有很多同学都兼职做网课代刷的代理。南都记者进的网课代看群里，也有好几人私聊记者是否要做下级代理。

其中一位昵称为“猪头”的网课代刷服务提供者发给了南都记者一个“代刷网”，其中也包括数十个网课平台的代刷服务。猪头告诉南都记者，这些服务都来自代刷平台，他可以帮记者在代刷平台注册一个账号，这样记者就也有了一个个人的代刷网，记者也就成了“猪头”的下家代理。

只要在平台存一定的余额，记者就也能凭借代刷网去做这门生意。而平台给代理的课程价格，最低只要0.8元，最高的也才3.8元，在平台上预存的钱越多，每门课的单价就越低。最低要预存50元，最高预存到2000元则可以享受最低价格的课程单价。

“猪头”强调，“不是我收你的钱，这些钱是存到平台余额里，刷课用的是余额里的钱”。

results.title: 大学网课竟能代刷代考 10元钱一门课 - 产经 > 正文
results.summary:
# 大学网课竟能代刷代考 10元钱一门课
...
仅需10元就能刷完一门课，还可帮助学生代考完成章节测试。记者近日发现，在电商平台上，一些商家标注的网络教育课程视频代录制的服务，其实却在做着代刷网课的生意。随着“互联网+”教育的发展，网课成为高校教育的重要补充资源，然而一些大学生却动起了歪脑筋，想要“不学而过”。于是，有商家迅速嗅到了“商机”，提供违规服务。

乱象 10元刷完一门网课

“网课，找我！”“一站式服务”“所有课程都可以学”……记者在电商平台上搜索关键词“刷课”，便能找到许多提供网络课程视频录制服务、网课咨询服务的店铺，这些服务的标价多在5元到10元之间，多家店铺的月销量超过1000件。

究竟是“代录制”还是“代刷课”？是提供“咨询服务”还是“代考服务”？记者随机打开其中一家店铺的商品详情页，看到“只做网课代录，违规服务勿扰”的字样。然而，在商品评论区里，记者却看到了不一样的内容：不少买家晒出刷课完成的截图，还有买家给出好评，表示“速度很快，课都搞的很好，超级满意，帮我省下很多时间”“合作过几次了，还是一如既往的好，不愧是专业的，一口气帮我完成了继续学习”。

随后，记者向客服询问：“代刷课可以吗？”客服立刻给出肯定的答复，并表示，现在平台监管严格，需要加微信号，切换至微信进一步沟通。

探访 刷课代考猫腻忒多

记者随机选择一家店铺进行深入了解。该店铺客服表示，提供慢刷和快刷两种服务。有些网课平台会设置规律学习分，要求学习天数，这种情况下如果要获得该项满分，则需要选择慢刷服务，30元一门。如果选择快刷则是10元一门。客服表示，“今天完工，明早检查”，不管是慢刷还是快刷都可以包做章节测试，“基本满分包过”。记者询问卖家用什么方法完成时，卖家表示“不是人工也不是脚本，我们有自己的方法”，具体方式不能透露。

另一家提供人工刷课服务的卖家报价是20元一门，只负责刷视频时长，不包括完成章节测试。还有一家使用脚本刷课的卖家可以支持学习通、中国大学MOOC等8个平台的刷课服务，10元一门，除了固定时间点考试及专业性太强的课程，其他都可以完成章节测试。

提醒 刷课代考将被处理

高校面向学生开设的在线课程，很多都是对传统课堂教学的补充。但是，大学生们花钱刷课已经成为一个公开的秘密。

某大学大一学生赵同学说：“有些网课真的没有价值，还要耗很长时间，肯定会有人找别人刷”。对此，她希望网课平台可以提高网课质量，吸引学生兴趣。同时，需要平台、学校、相关部门多方监管，减少这种现象的发生。

大学生黄同学坦言，曾购买过人工代刷课服务，需要提供课程平台的账号及密码给专人。随后，他便经常接到学历提升、英语培训等骚扰电话。“购买这种服务非常可能有泄露隐私的风险。”黄同学说。

记者注意到，有网课平台针对出现的第三方软件“刷课”现象发布公告，表示会通过技术手段重点通查课程学习记录，一旦发现有刷课或代考等行为，则会通报学校教务部门对该学生学习进度进行清零、课程学习清退处理。

北京法律援助中心律师表示，付费刷课如果形成产业链，并到规模化发展的程度，就会构成违法犯罪。

实习记者 鹿杨 实习生 占雯佳

# GitHub - TheMythologist/GenP: Automatically builds GenP executables from source · GitHub

# GenP — Adobe CC Universal Patcher (Open Source)

> **This repository is strictly for educational and archival purposes only.**

GenP (Generic Patcher) is an open-source Adobe patcher written in AutoIt that applies binary hex patches to Adobe Creative Cloud application files, modifying their licensing behavior. It supports Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Acrobat, Lightroom, and the rest of the CC suite on Windows 10 and 11.

Copies of GenP float around on Discord, Telegram, and random file hosts — and there's no way to tell if those binaries are clean or packed with malware. That's the problem this repo fixes:

  * **Source code is public.** The AutoIt source and all patch definitions (`config.ini`) are right here. Read them before you run anything.
  * **Builds happen on GitHub Actions, not someone's PC.** The CI workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) runs on GitHub-hosted runners. No one touches the binary between compilation and upload.
  * **Releases ship with SHA checksums.** You can verify that what you downloaded matches what CI produced, byte for byte.

If your copy didn't come from this repo's GitHub Releases page, you can't know what's in it.

## Origins

  * **Original project:** gen.paramore.su
  * **Community continuation & guides:** wiki.dbzer0.com/genp-guides

## History of GenP and Adobe

### Adobe Kills Perpetual Licenses (2013)

In 2013, Adobe dropped perpetual licenses for Creative Suite and went all-in on the Creative Cloud subscription model. A lot of people hated it. Surveys at the time put the number at 87% of users preferring the old model. For hobbyists, students, and freelancers who couldn't justify the recurring cost, piracy tools became the workaround.

### GenP Shows Up (~2019)

GenP first appeared around 2019. A developer going by **Uncia** built it as a universal Adobe CC patcher — one tool that could patch Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and the rest of the suite in one shot. It worked by applying hex patches to application binaries, disabling the Adobe Genuine Service (AGS), licensing checks, and phone-home calls.

The **r/GenP** subreddit quickly became the main hub for downloads, guides, and troubleshooting.

### Version History

Version | When | What Changed  
---|---|---  
2.0 | ~2019 | First multi-app patcher for Adobe CC 2019  
2.4–2.5 | 2020 | Stability fixes, CC 2019–2020 compat  
2.7 | 2021–2022 | Partial Acrobat support  
3.0 | ~2023 | Hosts file bypass, full Acrobat support — Uncia's last release  
3.4+ | 2024 | Taken over by the CGP community  
3.7.x | 2025 | Latest Adobe versions, Windows 10/11  

### Uncia Steps Down, CGP Takes Over

Uncia retired from the scene in early 2023 and dropped GenP 3.0.3 (listed on Reddit as GenP 3.0) with the full source code. The **CGP (Community GenP)** group picked it up from there, keeping it working against newer Adobe releases. The credits in current versions read: _"Original version by Uncia — CGP + GenP Community Edition."_

### How Adobe Fought Back

Adobe didn't just sit and watch. Their response came in waves:

  * **Adobe Genuine Service (AGS)** — a background process that flags modified installs and nags users with "non-genuine software" warnings.
  * **Anti-crack updates (2022)** — Adobe CC version 23.x shipped with detection code specifically targeting GenP patches, breaking older versions of the tool overnight.
  * **DMCA takedowns (2025)** — Adobe went after hosting platforms and communities distributing GenP with formal DMCA notices.
  * **Selective enforcement** — Adobe doesn't brick every patched install. They use a mix of warnings, feature degradation, and targeted lockouts. Casual users mostly get left alone (they stay in the Adobe ecosystem), while commercial use gets cracked...

Unlicenced or sometimes offline Adobe apps are strive to interrupt your work with annoying popup messages. This counts following messages:

  2. Unskipable warning when Photoshop cannot access internet
  3. Forced licence accept window. You have no option to decline the licence and continue working.

It supports: Photoshop, Premiere Pro, After Effects 

This tool is created ~~to fuck Adobe~~ to give you more freedom and allow to use Photoshop/Premiere Pro or AfterEffects without stupid restrictions (like offline mode) or accepting licence terms when it forces you to do that. This program is realtime monitoring software to detect annouying popup windows in Photoshop. When such windows appers it instantly closes this window, unlocks Photoshop main window and makes it focused, so you can keep working without being interrupted.

# How to use

This is not neccessary, but if you don't need cloud features and want to force the Photoshop to work in offline mode I recommend you to block Adobe hosts by adding them into your Windows **hosts** file.   
You should do it manually, psunlock does not mess with your system files.   
List of Adobe hosts can be found here: https://github.com/Ruddernation-Designs/Adobe-URL-Block-List/blob/master/hosts   
This will force Adobe apps to run in offline mode.

  1. Put **psunlock.exe** into your Photoshop/Premiere or AE folder
  2. Create a desktop shortcut for **psunlock.exe**

## Method B

  1. Run **psunlock.exe** from any folder.
  2. Run Adobe app (Different apps at once supported). (You can launch **psunlock.exe** after any Adobe app that is supported by this unlocker)

### WikiFlix goes live

May 2, 2025

WikiFlix, a new free streaming platform developed by Wikimedia Germany, the parent company of Wikidata, has gone live.

The service gives users access to a library of freely licensed films and aims to provide an alternative to commercial streaming giants, while complementing public broadcaster media libraries. Some of the titles available include 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1916), Scarface (1932), Nosferatu (1922) and It’s a Wonderful Life (1946).

WikiFlix requires no login or registration, allowing users to dive straight into its catalogue spanning action, westerns, comedies and documentaries. While many of the 2,500+ films are in English, viewers can also enjoy content in French, Danish, Russian, and Japanese.

The idea for WikiFlix and its name originally came from the Wikipedian ‘Spinster’, aka Sandra Fauconnier, who inspired fellow WikiMedian, Magnus Manske, to develop the free streaming service using Wikidata to ensure WikiFlix showcased the latest films.
...
WikiFlix doesn’t host the content itself. Instead, it uses linked data from Wikidata to access public domain content on the Internet Archive, Wikimedia Commons, and YouTube.

“WikiFlix democratises access to film, offering a rich and varied selection without the constraints of paywalls or subscriptions,” explained Lydia Pintscher, Portfolio Lead Product Manager, Wikidata. “We believe in the power of open access, and this platform embodies that ethos. You don’t need any registration, login credentials or wiki knowledge to use WikiFlix. Anyone can search for and watch films. Users can explore cinematic treasures from around the world, completely free of charge.”

The service also features more recent open-source productions, such as the 2008 animated short Big Buck Bunny, created using Blender, a free 3D animation software. WikiFlix provides detailed information about each film, including its production history and licensing details.

# This Under-the-Radar Site Lets You Stream Classic Movies for Free With Zero Ads

A hidden gem of a streaming service called WikiFlix allows anyone to watch movies that have entered the public domain for free without ads. Even better, the website uses an interface that is similar to Netflix’s, and you don’t even need an account to start watching classic films (and more) on the site. Some other streamers, like Hulu and Tubi, have older movies in their catalog too, but they either require a monthly payment or ask users to watch ads to access them.

## Wikiflix adds new public domain films often

Every year, new films enter the public domain as their copyrights expire, and Wikiflix adds these movies to its library frequently. The streaming website draws films from other sites, including YouTube, The Internet Archive, and Wikimedia Commons and compiles them all in one place.

Copyright law in the United States can be difficult to decipher, but in general, films enter the public domain after 95 years. So the vast majority of movies that were published in 1930 have entered the public domain at the start of 2026.

That said, there are more recent films that can be found on the platform too, like the Edward Snowden documentary Citizenfour (2014), It’s A Wonderful Life (1946), and House on Haunted Hill (1959). For easy viewing, the site’s library is separated into categories, like educational films, zombie films, romantic comedies, and animated cartoons.

As a quick sample, some of the most viewed movies on Wikiflix include Metropolis (1927), A Trip to the Moon (1902), Battleship Potemkin (1925), and Nosferatu (1922).

Several controversial films, such as The Birth of a Nation, have been blacklisted on the streaming service, with a page on its website stating that they are “perfectly fine in an educational context.” But since Wikiflix is “focused on entertainment,” they will not found its catalog.

It’s nice to remember that not everything on the internet needs to be a subscription-based platform with ads. On WikiFlix, a Netflix-inspired archive of public domain films, you can watch movies like “It’s a Wonderful Life” and “Nosferatu” for free. You don’t even have to make an account!
...
A project of Wikipedia’s volunteer community, WikiFlix hosts over 4,000 movies from Wikimedia Commons, the Internet Archive, or YouTube that have fallen into the public domain — that means they are free to share and distribute, usually because the copyright lapsed, or there was never any copyright at all. So, yes, most of the movies on the WikiFlix homepage are your grandma’s age, but isn’t it kind of fun to imagine what Netflix would’ve been like back in the day?

WikiFlix isn’t new, but it’s new to us, courtesy of a TikTok by Annie Rauwerda, the creator behind the “Depths of Wikipedia” accounts.

While WikiFlix can introduce you to historic films like “Wings,” the first movie to win the Academy Award for Best Picture, there’s also a bunch of hidden gems on there. As Rauwerda says in her TikTok, “Sometimes I really like watching things that I know nobody else is watching, because what if I discover something crazy?”

On its homepage, WikiFlix prioritizes movies that have a lot of sitelinks on their Wikipedia pages, since those are more likely to be popular or interesting. But there is some degree of curation. The community around WikiFlix maintains a blacklist, which helps ensure that you’re not going to run into a historical Nazi propaganda film during your next “WikiFlix and chill” night. (“While these [films] are perfectly fine in an educational context, WikiFlix is more focused on entertainment,” a WikiFlix page says.)

WikiFlix content may not exactly be as binge-worthy as “Stranger Things,” but give it a try. Why not watch a Soviet musical inspired by Cinderella, a silent film about swashbuckling pirates, or a Japanese post-apocalyptic film that features a guy who somehow played for both the Boston Celtics and the Chicago Cubs? You can always catch up on “Love Is Blind” another time.

results.title: Cheap Instagram Followers: Honest 2026 Risk Breakdown
results.summary:
## Hidden costs and how Instagram detects fake followers

Most articles that pitch cheap Instagram followers stop at the price. The price is the easy part. What costs you is the engagement-rate collapse, the algorithmic suppression that follows, the brand-deal audit, and in repeat cases the account flag for inauthentic activity. The matrix below maps each follower tier across the four risks that decide whether a purchase merely wastes the money or actively damages the account.

### Engagement rate collapses inside 48 hours

Engagement rate is the single hardest metric to fake. It is likes plus comments divided by follower count, and bots add to the denominator while contributing nothing to the numerator. An account at 4 percent on 1,000 real followers falls to 0.7 percent after a 5,000 bot pack lands. Brand-deal scouts treat anything below 1.5 percent as a red flag, per the rate cards published by Later's 2026 influencer rate report. A 5,000-follower account with 0.7 percent engagement is worth less to a sponsor than a 1,000-follower account at 4 percent, which is the inverted incentive that makes the purchase a self-inflicted wound.

### Algorithmic suppression follows the engagement signal

The Instagram recommendation system was overhauled in 2024 to weight the ratio of engaged followers to total followers more heavily than raw follower count. Adam Mosseri confirmed the change publicly on his Creators blog. When a buyer pads the follower count without the engagement backing it, the ratio cratered, and reach on subsequent posts falls roughly 30 to 60 percent. That suppresses real engagement further, which sinks the ratio more, which suppresses reach more. The loop is sometimes called the spiral, and a single bot purchase can kick it off on an otherwise healthy account.

### Brand-deal audits surface the purchase in under a minute

Every modern brand-deal pipeline runs an automated audit before a contract is signed. The standard tools are HypeAuditor, Modash, and Phlanx. All three score follower authenticity by running the same detection signals Instagram uses internally: follower-to-following ratios, default avatars, post-count distribution, geographic clustering, and posting cadence on the followers themselves. A bot-padded account scores in the lowest decile within seconds, and most sponsorship contracts treat that score as an automatic disqualification.

### Account suspension follows repeat violations

Instagram's Community Guidelines on inauthentic activity treat buying followers as a violation. The first detection usually triggers a silent purge of the bots and a short reach suppression. Repeat purchases compound into account warnings, feature limitations (loss of comments, DMs, or the ability to follow new accounts), and in the worst cases a permanent suspension. Recovery from a suspension involves a manual review and is rarely successful when the trigger is a confirmed buy.

## How Instagram detects bought followers

The detection model has been public for years. Sellers know it. They optimise around the cheapest signals (avatar, post count) and ignore the harder ones (geographic clustering, batch-follow timing). Below are the five signals that catch nearly every cheap-follower purchase, in the order Meta's integrity team runs them.

- Follower-to-following ratio. Real users follow more accounts than they have followers, especially on new accounts. A new follower with 5,000 outbound follows and 12 followers themselves trips the first filter instantly.
- Default avatar and zero-post profile. Bot accounts skip the time-consuming step of uploading a profile photo or any posts. Any flood of new followers where most of them ship with the default silhouette is a textbook signal.
- Batch-follow timing. Real audiences arrive in a long-tail curve over hours and days. A purchased pack arrives in clustered bursts of hundreds of follows per minute, which the timing detector flags before any of the per-account signals run.
- IP and geographic clustering. Click-farm followers route through a small number of IP addresses in a handful of cities. A North American account with 80 percent of its new followers from one Asian city in 48 hours is the archetypal pattern.
- Engagement-rate divergence. The longest-running signal. A follower count that grows without a matching engagement curve is the smoke that confirms the fire.

## What to do instead: the organic growth playbook

The honest alternative is slower in the first month and compounds harder afterwards. The five-step loop below is the same workflow we run inside SocialCRM for the creators on the platform. Median follower-add over a 90-day window for accounts starting under 1,000 followers is 4,800, against zero ad spend.

- Niche down hard.Pick one specific topic and one specific audience....

### Social Media Management Software

Boostero is not designed as a scheduling or publishing solution. It does not handle content posting, calendar management, or brand monitoring, and it is not meant to replace platforms like Hootsuite, Buffer, or Later. Boostero is a specialized SMM panel designed specifically for repeat customers and resellers, rather than for individual transactions. # How Much Do Instagram Followers Cost in 2026? The Transparent Pricing Guide Nobody Publishes

Published: July 13, 2026 | Category: Instagram Growth, Pricing | Read Time: 8 min | Author: IndianSMMServices.com Team

Quick answer: In 2026, 1,000 Instagram followers cost anywhere from under ₹100 (about a dollar) for bot-tier accounts to a few hundred rupees for high-quality profiles with refill guarantees, up to several times that for real-user followers — a 5–10x spread that is entirely explained by quality tier. The same services cost 3–10x more on retail "buy followers" websites, because most of those sites fulfill orders through wholesale SMM panels and pocket the markup. The price you should pay depends on one question: will anyone inspect your follower list? If yes, buy quality tiers. If you are comparing providers, compare tier-for-tier — a cheap price on the wrong tier is the most expensive purchase in this market.

Most providers keep pricing vague until checkout. After 1,000,000+ orders since 2019, we would rather publish the honest structure of the market — including the parts that explain why our own catalog shows prices upfront.

## The 2026 Price Map, Tier by Tier

Every follower service in the world falls into the three tiers we anatomized in our real vs HQ vs bot guide, and price follows tier with near-perfect consistency:

- Bot tier — the floor: mass-created empty accounts, often priced under ₹100 per thousand at wholesale. Instant delivery, heavy drops, usually no refill. You are paying for a number, and the price honestly reflects that.
- High-quality (HQ) tier — the value zone: complete-looking profiles with photos and posts, typically a few hundred rupees per thousand with 30-day or longer refill windows. This is where roughly 80% of smart money goes — the credibility-per-rupee sweet spot for creators, businesses, and the local business playbook.
- Real tier — the ceiling: genuine users from promotion networks, priced several times HQ rates, delivered gradually, with the strongest retention and the only engagement potential. The tier for brand-deal influencers and anyone facing sponsor scrutiny.
- Targeting premium: country-specific followers — Indian, US, UK audiences — cost meaningfully more than worldwide mixes at every tier, because targeted delivery networks are smaller. Worth it when your buyers are local; wasted when only the count matters.

Exact live rates change with market conditions, which is why serious buyers check the per-service pricing on the services list — every service shows its rate, tier description, speed, and refill terms before payment, not after.

## The Markup Nobody Mentions: Panel vs Retail Websites

Search "buy Instagram followers" and the polished websites in the ads charge many times wholesale rates. Here is the industry's open secret: most retail follower sites are resellers fulfilling orders through wholesale panels — often through APIs exactly like the one in our automation guide. The product is identical; the markup pays for their Google Ads. Buying from a cheapest SMM panel directly is simply buying at the wholesale layer — the same reason smart shoppers buy from the mandi, not the mall. (And if you are on the other side of that trade, the reseller margin is precisely the business model our SMM reseller panel program exists for.)

## Red-Flag Pricing: When Cheap and Expensive Both Scam You

- Too cheap for the claim: "10,000 real active followers for ₹99" is a tier lie — real-tier quality cannot exist at bot-tier prices, economically. You will receive bots labeled as real. The tier test from our trust checklist catches this instantly.
- Too expensive for the tier: retail sites charging premium rates for what their descriptions quietly reveal is HQ or bot tier — the markup trap above. Compare tier-for-tier, never price-for-price.
- "Free" pricing: the most expensive tier of all, paid in passwords and spam actions — fully anatomized in our free followers exposé.
- Prices hidden until signup + deposit: transparent operators show rates publicly. Hidden pricing exists to trap deposited balances.

## The Comparison Buyers Actually Need: Followers vs Ads vs Agencies

For the specific job of building follower count and social proof, the cost gap is dramatic: follower-growth ad campaigns commonly work out to many times panel rates per follower gained, and social media agencies bundle the same panel-fulfilled growth inside monthly retainers costing more than a year of direct panel spend — the full math lives in our ads vs SMM panel breakdown...
